quotes.text: - Responsabilidades de cuidado de hijos u otros familiares
- Quiere cuidar personalmente de hijos u otros familiares
- Dedicado a las labores del hogar

assessments.reasoning:
The survey instrument was examined across all sections for questions regarding unpaid domestic and care work. 

1. Responsibility: The instrument contains no questions asking who is in charge of, plans, or takes responsibility for domestic or care tasks. Thus, responsibility evaluates to false.

2. Performance: The instrument includes options referencing domestic work or caregiving, such as in Section C, question 26 ('- Responsabilidades de cuidado de hijos u otros familiares'), Section C, question 27 ('- Quiere cuidar personally de hijos u otros familiares'), and Section H, question 1 ('- Dedicado a las labores del hogar'). However, per the operational instructions, categories defining activity status or reasons for working part-time or not working do not count as explicit questions about carrying out domestic or care tasks. The questionnaire does not contain any direct questions asking whether a person performs these tasks. Thus, performance evaluates to false.

3. Magnitude: The instrument does not record the time or frequency spent on unpaid domestic or care work. Thus, magnitude evaluates to false.
